name: Precarious Thunderstone Trap

source.title: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg

disable: DC 15 Thievery check (trained) to remove the thunderstone or DC 18 Reflex save save to catch the falling thunderstone

items.name: Thunderstone
items.text:
Trigger The front gate is opened

---

Effect A moderate thunderstone falls on the flagstones and activates, dealing 2 splash sonic splash damage to each creature within 10 feet of the gate. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save saving throw or be Deafened for 1 round. Adjacent creatures can attempt to catch the falling thunderstone (see Disable).

text: A tripwire fastened to the gate snaps when the gate is opened, releasing a moderate thunderstone to the ground.
